analysis.coverage_limits: Python coverage does not independently enumerate every Boolean subcondition or prove CUDA DMA lifetime. Targeted native-mask comparisons, delayed-stream allocation reuse, actual wrappers, IPC, complete-parent parity and deliberate faults supply separate evidence. This is not full worker or repository coverage.

analysis.scope: Four new CUDA cases cover inference scores then gradients, BF16/FP32 and default/nondefault streams; one CPU case covers a class embedding-getter observer. All five pass in ordinary and deterministic modes in both environments.
analysis.limits: The five added cases were run locally on the 4090. The Blackwell archive contains the earlier 304-case focused subset and identical production code. No additional remote case is claimed.
